column1: # ================= *** THE FINDING, AND IT IS A CLOSURE RATHER THAN A JOIN *** =================
# *** RAMON IS NATURAL DE VALDEMORO, IN CASTILLA LA NUEVA. *** Valdemoro is a town about twenty-seven
# kilometres south of MADRID. *** SANCHO WAS "NATURAL DE CORDOVA LA LLANA" - ANDALUSIA, five hundred
# kilometres away. ***
# *** SO THE TWO URUGUAYAN LERENA HOUSES ARE TWO SEPARATE SPANISH IMMIGRATIONS. *** They are not
# brothers, they are not cousins out of one town, and the surname entered the Banda Oriental
# *** TWICE, from opposite ends of Spain. ***
# *** AND THE COINCIDENCE THAT MADE IT WORTH ASKING IS NOW EXPLAINED AND DISCHARGED. ***
# This archive noticed that Sancho's father is written *** "FELIZ GERENA" *** on a Montevideo act of
# *** 1811 *** and Ramon's father *** "SALVADOR GERENA" *** on one of *** 1812 ***, and said the shared
# spelling was "a scribal habit of one place and one time rather than two families choosing the same
# variant by chance." *** THAT WAS EXACTLY RIGHT, AND IT WAS A REASON TO LOOK RATHER THAN TO BELIEVE. ***
# The act shows the same clerk-world writing *** SERENA ***, not Gerena - and both men were baptising
# children at *** THE SAME CHURCH, THE IGLESIA MATRIZ OF MONTEVIDEO, ONE YEAR APART. *** Two families
# of the same rare surname, in one small city, at one font, from opposite ends of Spain.
# *** WHAT THE ACT GIVES THAT THE INDEX DID NOT. ***
what
The father's surname
column3: *** "RAMON SERENA" *** - and SERENA is one of the very spellings the army drawer of Cajon 985 interfiles with Lerena, Lorena and Lera.

column1: # *** WHAT IT COSTS AND WHAT IT BUYS. ***
# *** IT COSTS the hope that the Uruguayan Lerenas would turn out to be one kindred and that Pablo
# Armando might be found somewhere inside it. *** Two arrivals means two haystacks, not one.
# *** IT BUYS a hard place-name where there was none. *** Ramon's people are from VALDEMORO, and
# Valdemoro parish registers are a finite, searchable thing. *** SALVADOR SERENA and ANA DE CUBAS were
# married in Spain, and their marriage is findable. ***
# *** AND IT BUYS A METHOD POINT WORTH MORE THAN EITHER: *** the index gave four facts and the act gave
# nine, including the only one that mattered. *** The image was free, it was one click from a record
# this archive had already found, and it sat unopened for a day. ***
# ============ AND THEN VALDEMORO WAS TESTED, THE SAME DAY - row 141 ============
# *** The act bought a hard Spanish place-name. The first thing to ask of a place-name is whether its
# registers are reachable, and the answer here is NO - not from this desk. ***
test
